_about.what: When the polls open and close on November 3, 2026, state by state (and by county where a state spans two time zones), and each state's own polling-place lookup. Daylight time ends November 1, so every time is standard time.
_about.how: Each closing time was read on 2026-10-10 from the state's statute or its election office's own page, one polite request at a time with the site's honest User-Agent. A source marked 'cited' was not read by script and says why. Time-zone counties follow 49 CFR Part 71. Lookups were asked once each; a site that refused a script was not asked again, and hosts on the site's never list (every Minnesota Secretary of State host among them) were never requested.
_about.times: closes is the local clock time; closes_utc the same moment in UTC. latest is the latest a polling place may close where the state lets localities choose (Kansas, New Hampshire, North Dakota).
_about.in_line: Every state lets a voter already in line at closing time vote.
